## From the Caribbean Sea to the Maya cities

Mexico has coastlines on both the Atlantic and Pacific, and this route focuses on the Yucatán Peninsula and nearby areas. Beaches and warm waters sit alongside Maya cities, colonial architecture and archaeological sites with traces of several historical periods.

Over 6 days you’ll see the port city of Tulum, the jungles of Calakmul and Palenque, the fortified city of Campeche, and the architecture of Uxmal and Chichén Itzá. Round off a full programme of sightseeing with a swim in the cool waters of the Ik Kil cenote.
